stories.title: Crown Prince Receives Call from King of Jordan Condemning Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: Crown Prince Receives Call from King of Jordan Condemning Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The King of Jordan called Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince to express condemnation of Houthi attacks against the Kingdom.

stories.title: Riyadh governor conveys royal greetings to injured airport attack victims

en.title: Riyadh governor conveys royal greetings to injured airport attack victims
en.summary: Riyadh's governor visited victims injured in a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport and delivered greetings from Saudi Arabia's leadership wishing them recovery.

stories.title: WPC Energy Congress: Saudi Arabia Eyes Raising East-West Pipeline Capacity to 10 Million Barrels per Day

en.title: WPC Energy Congress: Saudi Arabia Eyes Raising East-West Pipeline Capacity to 10 Million Barrels per Day
en.summary: Saudi Arabia is considering increasing the capacity of its East-West pipeline to 10 million barrels per day, discussed at the World Petroleum Council Energy Congress.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s ‘mindset’ helped Kingdom beat longest energy crisis says minister

en.title: Saudi Arabia's 'mindset' helped Kingdom beat longest energy crisis says minister
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's energy minister credited the country's preparedness strategy for overcoming its most severe energy crisis amid regional conflicts affecting oil flows.

stories.title: Riyadh emir visits civilians injured in Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport

en.title: Riyadh emir visits civilians injured in Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport
en.summary: Prince Faisal bin Bandar visited injured civilians from Houthi attacks on Riyadh's airport, conveying wishes for recovery from King Salman and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, and reaffirming leadership directives to provide healthcare to those harmed.

stories.title: India becomes 10th country to lose citizen to Houthi strike on Riyadh airport

en.title: India becomes 10th country to lose citizen to Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An Indian national from Hyderabad died from injuries sustained in Houthi missile attacks on King Khalid International Airport, making India the tenth country whose citizens were killed in the weekend strikes that caused multiple fatalities and injuries.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia will overcome challenges, uphold global energy commitments, Prince Abdulaziz says

en.title: Saudi Arabia will overcome challenges, uphold global energy commitments, Prince Abdulaziz says
en.summary: Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman stated that Saudi Arabia will maintain its international energy commitments and continue its transformation agenda despite regional challenges and infrastructure attacks, emphasizing the importance of energy security resilience.

stories.title: Riyadh airport attack: When a strategy backfires

en.title: Riyadh airport attack: When a strategy backfires
en.summary: The article analyzes the Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport as a deliberate act by an organization seeking confrontation to justify its operations and validate sponsorship.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia extends suspension of operations at Riyadh airport following Houthi attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia extends suspension of operations at Riyadh airport following Houthi attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority extended the suspension of operations at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh following Houthi attacks. The extension allows time for safety inspections and verification of airport facilities before resuming operations.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia positions Riyadh as global energy security hub as WPC Energy Congress opens

en.title: Saudi Arabia positions Riyadh as global energy security hub as WPC Energy Congress opens
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Energy Minister stated the kingdom intends to remain central to global energy security while pursuing its long-term strategy. The 25th WPC Energy Congress opened in Riyadh for the first time, running through mid-October.

stories.title: Global condemnation mounts over deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh airport

en.title: Global condemnation mounts over deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport
en.summary: Multiple countries and international organizations condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people and injured 309 civilians, with the UAE describing it as a violation of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty.

stories.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people and injured 309 others, reaffirming Pakistan's commitment to Saudi Arabia's security and territorial integrity.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Oct. 8
en.summary: Major ownership changes occurred on the Tadawul stock exchange on October 8.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia attracts SAR 6T investments since strategy launch: Minister

en.title: Saudi Arabia attracts SAR 6T investments since strategy launch: Minister
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Investment Minister reported that domestic and international investments have reached approximately 6 trillion riyals since launching the National Investment Strategy. Gross fixed capital formation nearly doubled from 2020 to 2025, with private sector investment increasing from 59% to 77% of total investment.

stories.title: ‎Riyadh sees exceptional growth, 2 bridges 42% complete: RCRC CEO

en.title: Riyadh sees exceptional growth, 2 bridges 42% complete: RCRC CEO
en.summary: Riyadh's development authority head reported exceptional economic and urban growth in the capital, with ongoing projects to develop 700 kilometers of roads and 300 kilometers of intersections. Two parallel bridges under construction are 42% complete.

stories.title: ‎Aramco targets 80% increase in gas sales capacity by 2030: CEO

en.title: Aramco targets 80% increase in gas sales capacity by 2030: CEO
en.summary: Saudi Aramco aims to increase gas sales capacity by approximately 80% from 2021 levels by 2030 while expanding renewable energy projects. The company expects gas and renewables to each comprise half of Saudi Arabia's electricity generation by 2030.

stories.title: ‎TASI falls 0.7% to 10,284 pts, record lowest close in 43 months

en.title: TASI falls 0.7% to 10,284 pts, record lowest close in 43 months
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's TASI stock index declined 0.7% to close at 10,284 points, marking its lowest closing level in 43 months.
